evaluation_diagnostics.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Pre-specified field results showing that the report changes live installer decisions versus OEM dashboards, followed by repeat paid orders from at least three unrelated installers, measured avoided-visit or incremental-retrofit value, contribution margin and delivery time per report, and written confirmation of durable OEM data-access and commercial-use terms.
evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Make the product commercially contingent on a narrow outcome-backed installer contract: charge only for a pre-defined avoided-visit or retrofit-qualification decision, record the counterfactual and realised outcome, and stop the offer if unrelated installers do not reorder; this would turn the report from generic analysis into a measurable workflow control point and seed the only plausible proprietary case asset.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: The one-OEM, read-only, event-priced wedge converts an overbroad optimisation concept into a low-capital test tied to a concrete installer decision, with exceptional initial access through the founder's family company.
evaluation_diagnostics.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that the report produces enough incremental decision value over OEM tools and installer judgment to generate repeat orders, attractive contribution margins, or a scalable path beyond bespoke event analysis.
evaluation_diagnostics.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: SolarEdge already bundles tariff-, weather-, load-, battery-, device-scheduling and homeowner-control functions, while Fronius exposes professional monitoring and control APIs under commercial terms; this shows that the generic data and optimisation layer is neither scarce nor safely outside OEM bundling.

evaluation_diagnostics.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Pre-specified trials showing that unrelated installers repeatedly pay 300-700 PLN, that the reports measurably avoid diagnostic visits or raise attributable retrofit gross profit versus existing OEM tools, and that delivery retains strong contribution margin after API, normalization, review, and support costs; this should be paired with durable commercial data-access rights and a credible estimate of paid-event volume in the single-OEM beachhead.
evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Secure a durable partner-controlled workflow and data right, such as an installer buying-group integration in which the report is embedded in retrofit quoting and paid from attributable installer gross profit, rather than remaining a standalone analysis that OEM dashboards can copy or bypass.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: The concept is tightly scoped around a real, monetizable installer event, uses a fixed price with explicit per-event payback, and exploits the founder's family-company access for a low-risk, read-only pilot.
evaluation_diagnostics.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that the report produces enough incremental decision value over existing OEM tools to generate repeat paid orders with attractive contribution margin and sufficient event volume for meaningful scale.
evaluation_diagnostics.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: SolarEdge already bundles tariff-, weather-, load-, battery-, and device-aware optimization and control, demonstrating that the core analytical functionality is reproducible by the OEM that controls the data and customer interface.

evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Make the embedded integrator the contracted reseller and economic buyer through a white-label portfolio agreement with minimum annual product-line volume, standardized platform boundaries, and explicit liability ownership; this would align the current gatekeeper, reduce bespoke acquisition, and turn the partner from a potential substitute into a committed distribution asset.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: The offer avoids competing on cheap transport and instead attaches payment and potential reuse to a concrete OEM release control point: vertical mappings, entitlement regression tests, request logs, and accepted evidence maintained in the customer cloud.
evaluation_diagnostics.primary_score_limiter: The concept has not established that a sufficiently large set of non-exempt OEMs both has this gap and will outsource it at attractive recurring economics, while its sole proposed distribution partner is also capable of bundling the solution.
evaluation_diagnostics.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Major IoT platforms already provide secure identity, APIs, data, and fleet functions, and open Thing Description standards make the generic layer reproducible, so the incumbent platform or integrator can plausibly bundle the missing access and logging surface before a vertical release library compounds.

evaluation_diagnostics.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A prepaid statement of work from a non-exempt OEM, a signed reseller or referral commitment with explicit support ownership, a credible internal-build or incumbent-integrator comparison, measured delivery hours and gross margin, and a second paid product line demonstrating reuse and a budgeted renewal would materially raise the score.
evaluation_diagnostics.highest_value_structural_change: Make the embedded integrator the contracted reseller and first-line support owner under a multi-OEM minimum-volume commitment, while the company licenses a standardized mapping and release-test engine and contractually retains reusable cross-OEM assets; this would turn the current channel dependency into repeatable distribution and clearer operating leverage.
evaluation_diagnostics.main_structural_strength: The opportunity converts a near-term statutory product-release obligation into a tightly bounded customer-cloud assurance control point, with prepaid implementation and recurring release evidence rather than an undifferentiated API or connectivity charge.
evaluation_diagnostics.primary_score_limiter: The model has not established that enough non-exempt OEMs will outsource this control point at the proposed price, or that mappings and tests will reuse sufficiently to support recurring margins and the large subscription count required for meaningful founder wealth.
evaluation_diagnostics.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Qualifying micro and small manufacturers are exempt, while established IoT platforms and integrators already provide most underlying capabilities and open standards make the generic layer reproducible; the remaining customer-specific legal, security, and semantic work may therefore be both narrower and more service-heavy than the thesis requires.

Pre-specified trials showing that unrelated installers repeatedly pay 300-700 PLN, that the reports measurably avoid diagnostic visits or raise attributable retrofit gross profit versus existing OEM tools, and that delivery retains strong contribution margin after API, normalization, review, and support costs; this should be paired with durable commercial data-access rights and a credible estimate of paid-event volume in the single-OEM beachhead.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Obtain a signed portfolio-partner agreement and results from at least five representative Polish audits showing invoice volume, recoverable cash, recovery time, dispute rate, precision, delivery hours, partner share, onboarding cost, and channel payback, followed by paid audit-to-monitoring conversions at the proposed price with measured prevented loss, review burden, gross margin, and retention.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence yet that the qualified Polish mid-market segment produces enough recoverable cash per client, at acceptable review cost and recovery speed, to support attractive contribution economics and then convert into durable recurring monitoring revenue.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The strongest quantified recovery case required analysis of 645,000 transactions plus a senior recovery auditor, while SAP and Microsoft already provide configurable matching controls; together these facts challenge both the economics at several-thousand-invoice SMEs and the distinctiveness of the core technology.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Results from the stated family-company pilot and three unrelated installers showing repeated paid orders at the proposed price, positive contribution margin after all API and human-support costs, documented avoided visits or incremental retrofit gross profit, stable commercial data rights, and baseline accuracy accepted by installers would justify materially higher scores.
records.primary_score_limiter: The business has no evidence yet that unrelated installers will repeatedly pay 300-700 PLN at event volumes and delivery margins sufficient to support attractive owner earnings, much less the founder's wealth objective.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: SolarEdge already bundles tariff-, weather-, load-, battery-, and device-aware optimisation while OEMs retain contractual and economic control over key data interfaces, showing that much of the technical layer is substitutable and the essential input can be gated.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Obtain three independent paid packages at or near 15000 PLN, then show at least two same-buyer repeat purchases, measured founder hours and exception rates, realised gross margin, buyer-recorded rework or labour savings, acquisition time and CAC, and a bottom-up count of reachable multi-project facilities with comparable recurring demand.
records.primary_score_limiter: The accountable-handoff premium is not yet connected to repeatable willingness to pay, attractive measured delivery economics, or a buyer population large enough to support substantial founder wealth, while free tools constrain pricing power.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: MNE-BIDS, the BIDS Validator, EEGLAB EEG-BIDS, and Brain Products' free BV2BIDS already cover much of conversion and validation, while guided open-source workflows show that mapping, review, QA, and validation are reproducible rather than intrinsically scarce.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A signed integrator resale commitment with minimum volume, one prepaid OEM statement of work at the proposed price, a documented internal-or-incumbent build comparison, and a second paid release showing mapping/test reuse, renewal intent, delivery margin, security-review duration, and bounded support would materially raise the judgment.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that a sufficiently large set of non-exempt OEMs both has this unresolved gap and will outsource the release-path component at the proposed price rather than use its incumbent platform or integrator.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Azure IoT Hub and Cumulocity already provide identity, API, device, and fleet primitives, while W3C standardizes the generic interaction description, so the incumbent integrator or platform can plausibly bundle the remaining access and evidence layer from an advantaged customer position.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Run paid pilots on representative manufacturer data and obtain a competitor-referenced before-and-after record covering PSUR preparation hours, missing-link and audit-quality improvement, onboarding and validation labor, support load, sales-cycle length, subscription conversion and renewal intent, together with signed consultant channel commitments and a sourced count of reachable target manufacturers.
records.primary_score_limiter: The candidate has not established a sufficiently superior standalone control point or separate budget against QMS/PMS suites that already bundle complaints, risk, CAPA, reporting, and traceability, which constrains achievable pricing, distribution, retention, and domination potential.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Established vendors already sell substantially overlapping connected workflows: MasterControl explicitly links post-market activity, feedback, issue analysis, risk, and core quality processes, while Greenlight Guru combines feedback, regulatory-reporting assessment, CAPA, risk, and traceability and reports adoption by more than 1,100 medtech companies.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A cohort of closed-period pilots in tightly qualified Polish firms should report invoice volume and spend, true-positive rate, confirmed and cash-collected recovery, time to collection, disputes, delivery hours, gross margin, sales and onboarding cost, and then independently observed audit-to-monitoring conversion, retention and signed accountant or ERP-channel economics.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no segment-specific evidence that Polish mid-market invoice volumes and recoverable leakage can support attractive human-reviewed unit economics, nor a committed channel capable of acquiring enough trusted finance customers at acceptable CAC.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The best quantified recovery example required analysis of 645,000 transactions plus senior-auditor verification and recovery work, which directly challenges the premise that firms with only several thousand invoices can produce enough collectible leakage to cover manual effort and acquisition cost.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A pre-specified field pilot comparing recommendations with OEM defaults or simple schedules using a documented measurement boundary and baseline; paid trials from at least three unrelated installers showing avoided truck-roll cost or incremental retrofit gross profit exceeding twelve months of proposed fees; written first-OEM commercial terms covering account permission, data granularity, rate limits, reuse rights, pricing, and warranty treatment; and cohort evidence on renewal, support hours, API and hosting cost, gross margin, CAC payback, and a bottom-up count of reachable supported sites.
records.primary_score_limiter: The concept has not shown that installers will pay repeatedly for the report or that its value exceeds bundled OEM tools, while wealth-relevant scale likely requires the multi-OEM complexity that weakens margins and part-time executability.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: SolarEdge ONE already bundles tariff-, weather-, load-, battery-, and device-aware optimization, while documented SolarEdge and Fronius API constraints show that incumbents can both reproduce the core functionality and control the data access on which a vendor-neutral layer depends.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Obtain three to five paid same-category pilots showing sufficiently complete cross-platform reason and disposition records, at least one causally credible implemented intervention with verified avoidable loss above four times annual fees, standardized onboarding and review hours consistent with at least 70% gross margin, recurring renewal intent, and a signed referral or embedded-distribution commitment with measurable CAC.
records.primary_score_limiter: Plausible incremental willingness to pay and owner economics remain weak relative to low-priced incumbent coverage, so the current route does not yet show a compelling or timely path to the founder's 5m PLN net-worth objective.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: ReasonWhy already offers AI return-reason clustering, product loss ranking, recommended fixes, and impact tracking for $49-$199 monthly, while AfterShip and platform-native Allegro and Shopify capabilities cover much of the surrounding analytics and data workflow.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Across 10-20 export-capable intermediaries, obtain paid-audit conversion, customer-verified incremental recovery after incumbent reconciliation, administrator time saved, false-positive rate, exception minutes per customer-month, achievable monthly price, renewal intent, lawful data-access confirmation, and direct or referral CAC; the strongest evidence would show at least four times annual-fee value with under-six-month customer payback and low-touch repeatability across multiple carrier formats.
records.primary_score_limiter: The standalone overlay has not established incremental recovered value beyond low-priced incumbent reconciliation, leaving willingness to pay, retention, and an attractive founder-wealth path simultaneously uncertain.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: SuperBroker and Berg System already advertise commission-note import, paid-versus-internal verification, reports, and discrepancy handling, while SuperBroker lists only 99-199 PLN monthly and Applied Systems demonstrates that a system-of-record incumbent can bundle the same workflow.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Obtain three independently paid pilots with pre-agreed acceptance criteria and record price, hours and rework avoided, exception rate, delivery labor, gross margin, procurement cycle, and follow-on intent; also establish the reachable count of similar buyers, one paid referral commitment, and the exact validation requirements and budget for any regulated CRO tier.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no demonstrated willingness to pay, renewal behavior, reachable buyer count, or repeatable acquisition path for the accountability layer, while direct evidence shows that capable free and vendor-supplied alternatives already cover much of the underlying workflow.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: MNE-BIDS supports BIDS and multiple manufacturer formats, the BIDS Validator and EEGLAB cover validation and interchange, and Brain Products gives away a source-available BV2BIDS converter; together these show that generic conversion and guided validation are reproducible and can be bundled at zero price.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Obtain several independent paid pilots that quantify baseline and post-product days-to-invoice, missing-evidence exceptions and dispute losses; demonstrate a task competitors cannot reproduce with configuration alone; validate willingness to pay at a margin-supporting price, repeatable onboarding hours and support load, retention intent, a relevant customer denominator, and a written partner channel with credible CAC and payback.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence that contract-specific evidence gating creates enough incremental paid value over low-priced end-to-end incumbents to support the proposed pricing, margins, retention, or required customer scale.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Majsta publicly offers signed offers, milestone schedules, photo reports, acceptance protocols, and direct KSeF for PLN 39-89 per month, while Serwis Pro offers offline signed protocols, photos, and KSeF to the exact installation audience.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: One prepaid pilot from a confirmed non-exempt OEM; its internal-build or incumbent-integrator quote and decision rationale; measured integration hours and gross margin followed by reuse on a second product line; written security and legal acceptance of the responsibility boundary; a signed integrator referral or resale commitment; and credible counts, sales-cycle, renewal, CAC, and payback evidence for the beachhead.
records.primary_score_limiter: There is no evidence yet that enough non-exempt OEMs have this exact gap, will outsource a release-path component at the proposed price, or can be acquired with reusable integrations and attractive sales economics.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Major IoT platforms such as Azure IoT Hub and Cumulocity already expose identity, API, data, and fleet-management primitives, making platform or integrator bundling a credible substitute for a standalone gateway.
